declarations.rationale: Explicit meet/meeting and arrival for talks form the largest coherent family; coach roles are competing minority meanings.
Literal neighborhoods in larger New York boroughs form the largest geographic-containment family; chair nomination/office is distinct.
Return/go destination movement dominates; sporting venue participation is a distinct competing family.
Explicit sales and weapons-sale paths form the leading coherent family; shock, send and chair roles are not merged into it.
Speech-in geographic place is the largest identifiable family after inspecting person/place arguments; publication-in and athletic paths are distinct and will not establish geographic presence.
Political group control dominates the control paths; sports/corporate leadership and inverse individual leaders remain distinct.
Specific president office dominates, with a small organizational location and artistic-review minority.
Mixed co-director, balletmaster-in-chief and chair/department-director paths identify broad managerial office; no single title dominates this family. Spokesperson and ownership alone remain excluded.
Explicit country-to-minister paths form the coherent inverse minister family; does not infer head-of-government from unspecified minister.
All literal argument pairs are legislature-to-person and dominant paths identify legislative leadership.

Victim kill-object and passive killed-in paths provide four explicit death-place rows, exceeding three residence rows as the largest specific interpretable family. Active killing is not victim death; residence/shooting alone are not imported as death.
Testimony and addressed speech dominate; the receiving legislature or committee is the addressee.
All literal first arguments are teams and second arguments named coaches; explicit possessive coach paths resolve the otherwise noisy reporting and malformed coach paths.
Chair office/tenure family is uniquely interpretable amid dateline/place/agency and geographic disturbance paths; nominations alone still do not establish tenure.
Leave-for destination movement is the leading repeated path; geographic team relocation is distinct from membership and political control.
Explicit lobbyist paths total five and form the largest specific role family; director of legislation, ownership and other roles remain separate.
Alias/known-as paths form the leading coherent family after checking literal retirement-system/Calpers roles; coaching, management and location remain competitors.
Legislative leader/majority-leader paths dominate with the person-to-body direction.
Auction-house premises, building, gallery and headquarters at street location form the largest coherent family; personal White House affiliation and sports champion meanings remain distinct.
Explicit attorney-for-public-jurisdiction role paths dominate; proposed Olympic destination and athlete/team movement are distinct.
